LanguageData.VME_CraftingSpeed_SlowerForManual.descri:
Manual processes are inefficient. We can't waste our precious lives toiling away in mindless manual labour.
<color=#E5E54C>Stats:</color> - Non-electric work table speed: -25%.
LanguageData.VME_DumbLabor_Horrible.description:
We should not suffer the dishonor of dumb labor.
<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> - Leader and Moralist roles will be incapable of Dumb Labor.
